title: console.error writes to stderr, not stdout
notes: WHATWG's warn/error stream split (crates/pool/src/wintertc.js: write(text, true)). Exit 0 -- console.error is not a failure. stdout must stay empty; see console_assert_false_stderr's note on repurposing expectedDiagnosticContains to assert a stderr substring, since the runner has no dedicated expected-stderr field.
